item.title: Yara inaugurates Europe’s largest carbon capture facility at Sluiskil
item.description: Yara has opened an industrial carbon capture facility at Sluiskil, capable of capturing and liquefying up to 800,000 tonnes of CO2 annually.

item.title: Dangote refinery to double capacity with $14.3bn investment
item.description: The Dangote Petroleum Refinery in Nigeria has disclosed plans to invest $14.3bn to expand its processing capacity, coinciding with the signing of documents for an initial public offering (IPO).

item.title: Oil prices surge after Houthi strikes on Saudi energy facilities
item.description: Oil prices rose to their highest levels in several weeks on 8 September, Tuesday, following attacks on Saudi energy facilities by Yemen’s Houthi movement and escalating tensions between Iran and the US.

item.title: OEUK Says Market Needs Firm Date for North Sea Tax Plan
item.description: Industry body Offshore Energies UK said the industry urgently needs a firm date for HM Treasury's North Sea tax plan.

item.title: Valve performance management is critical to the energy transition. Here’s why
item.description: Digital valve performance management - a structured, data-driven pathway to reduce emissions exposure while improving operational reliability.

item.title: Kistos secures Royal Decree for Oman Blocks 3 and 4 deal
item.description: UK-based energy firm Kistos has been granted a Royal Decree by the Sultanate of Oman relating to its acquisition of onshore Blocks 3 and 4 (Afar & Ghunaim) in Oman from Mitsui E&P Middle East.

item.title: Gazprom Boss Says Russia, Partners Have Enough Winter Gas
item.description: Alexey Miller, chair of the state-owned company's management committee, said Russia's underground gas storage inventories will reach a new all-time high this year.

item.title: Eni, Petronas to Jointly Explore High-Performance Biofuels
item.description: The Italian and Malaysian energy majors - partners with F1 teams - signed a collaboration agreement to test newer processes to produce biofuels for high-performance deployment.

item.title: China Buying More Oil despite Higher Prices
item.description: Undeterred by higher prices, importers shipped in 37.9 million tons last month, 6.2 percent more than in July, according to customs data.
